title: PCI-DSS: Immutable Audit Log for Payment Transactions
description:
Implement an immutable audit log table for all payment transaction events. Required for PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance (NEX-217).

Decision from architecture_review_01: Every payment event writes to the audit log BEFORE business logic executes. Log is append-only with row-level security — no UPDATE or DELETE permitted.

Schema:
- payment_audit_log(id, event_type, stripe_event_id, user_id, amount, currency, status, ip_address, timestamp)
- Partitioned by month (using pattern from NEX-189)
- Replicated to separate compliance schema with different access controls

PR #46 in progress — draft implementation available for review.
